purpose: One supported public item edit after the session’s fresh read barrier. The signed owned base must match the selected current head. Unknown tags and private encrypted content are retained. Failed/partial reads never authorize an empty base.
sets: The shared editor also supports public item edits to existing sets; new set coordinates and their service/UI capability belong to the contacts/lists stage.
base: full event ID of the verified observed current head, or empty only after a completed absence read; no raw original is supplied by the caller. The provider obtains the complete original from its verified store and preserves unknown tags/content.
